assets.description: Softly shaded lavender illustration of a phone connecting to a television, including all decorative artwork as one composition. Behind the devices is a large translucent pale lavender organic blob with a rounded upper peak and gently undulating lower edge. In the foreground at left, an upright phone has a thick dark lavender rounded frame, a pale screen and a vivid purple Wi-Fi symbol with two arcs and a dot. Four small purple dots curve upward and right from above the phone toward the television. The larger television occupies the center-right, with a thick rounded dark lavender bezel, softly shaded pale lavender display, central pedestal and broad low foot. On its screen is a pale rounded settings panel containing a dark lavender cog with a light circular center on the left and two lavender horizontal pill-shaped lines on the right, the upper line longer. Subtle translucent oval ground shadows sit below both devices. Preserve the soft gradients, diffuse texture and shaded edges.
